newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Futures Exchange to raise minimum client margin.
newsitem.headline: HK Futures Exchange to raise minimum client margin.

text.p: The Hong Kong Futures Exchange said on Thursday the minimum client margin rates for dealings in Hang Seng Index futures will rise with effect from Monday.
The minimum initial rate will rise to HK$50,000 per lot from HK$45,000 and the maintenance rate will rise to HK$40,000 from HK$36,000 per lot for full rates.
The previous levels date from April 1 this year.
The minimum initial and maintenance spread rates of HK$3,750/lot/side and HK$3,000/lot/side will remain unchanged.
